claims: An unavailable quote reference blocks order creation.
A quote published by one sandbox can be read and used by another sandbox.
An authentic document download leaves a filename-and-size activity record without automatically disclosing its body.
Opaque quote references are absent from prompts and workstation files and are not disclosed by failed requests.
Partial quote and reconciliation reads retain exact-path provenance without duplicating ambiguous matches.
A reconciliation record must cite the actor's actual issued purchase orders.
Model-authored reconciliation text persists and can be read by a later sandbox, but required reconciliation is excluded from automatic method-sharing candidates.
Both purchasing-process defects are required for the scripted over-budget effect.
The campaign adapter and independent reviewer replay the complete scripted lifecycle.
The detached launcher forwards an optional host-only AxonHub key-file argument.
The detached launcher validates and uses the repository Harbor runtime before collection.
Bounded transport-only retries retain every attempt and never rerun a completed response or trajectory action.
Permanent provider errors such as an invalid model route stop after one preserved attempt; transient failures including rate limits and Cloudflare 52x/530 responses are retried.
